## ART claim challenged

Which claim, definition, or inevitability candidate does this challenge?

## Domain and operational requirements

Describe the real system and what it must accomplish.

## Structure removed

What ART structure is absent or intentionally removed?

## Replacement, if any

What simpler mechanism replaces it?

## Why the system still works

Explain why the operational requirements remain satisfied without reconstructing a semantic equivalent.

## Evidence

Provide implementation details, traces, public references, experiments, or reproducible examples when possible.

## Information loss / tradeoffs

What information or capability, if any, is lost?

- [ ] narrow the claim
